versions.name: Rogers Scout Reservation
versions.summary: Natural State Council's summer camp reservation south of Booneville, Arkansas, built on former Booneville Sanatorium land, with a large dining hall, training lodge, and program areas surrounding Keenan Lake serving Cub Scout and Scouts BSA camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified against the Natural State Council's own Rogers Scout Reservation page, which lists resident summer camping for Cub Scouts and Scouts BSA, Webelos camp, and leader training. Council confirmed as Natural State (formed December 2023 from the Quapaw Area and Westark Area councils), which matches the source hint. Coordinates geocoded via US Census onelineaddress (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's own camp page; camp_type reservation with resident and training program types classified from the council page; features unsurveyed.
